description: Gram targets and kcal parts from a calorie target and whole-percent shares. protein_g = round(kcal * protein% / 400). fat_g = round(kcal * fat% / 900). carbs_g takes the rounding: round((kcal * (sum of the shares) / 100 - protein_g * 4 - fat_g * 9) / 4), which is the calorie target itself when the shares add up to 100, never below 0, and 0 when the carbs share is 0. The kcal parts are each share of the rounded calorie target, rounded down, with the leftover going to the largest remainders (tie: protein, then carbs, then fat), of kcal * (sum of the shares) / 100, so at 100 they add up to exactly the calorie target.
